tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.name: SuggestSkills
tools.description:
Render a card of standalone skills the user can add — org, shared, or Anthropic skills not yet enabled.

Call this when the task is one a skill could make repeatable — drafting in a house style, reviews against a playbook, a recurring workflow — and nothing enabled covers it; the user does not need to ask about skills. Also when they ask for recommendations, or when ListSkills returned zero matches. Use ListSkills for skills they already have.

Do NOT call this for one-off questions you can answer directly, when you are unsure a skill would help, or if you already rendered a suggestion this conversation and the user didn't engage.

Pass keywords drawn from the task itself, and set trigger ('proactive' when you initiated this from task context, 'user_asked' when they asked). If the result is empty and the trigger was proactive, continue the task without mentioning that you searched; if the user asked, tell them you found nothing new to add.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

tools.name: mcp__ccd_session__dismiss_task
tools.description:
Withdraw a background-task chip you previously created with spawn_task.

Call this when a suggestion you flagged is now stale, superseded, or irrelevant — e.g. you (or the user) already fixed it in this session, or you spawned a better-scoped replacement. To replace a chip: call spawn_task with the new suggestion first, then dismiss the old task_id.

Only chips the user hasn't acted on can be withdrawn from the queue. If the user already started or dismissed the task, the result says so (a dismissed task's copy kept for later is withdrawn too) — do not retry.

tools.name: mcp__ccd_session__mark_chapter
tools.description:
Mark the start of a new chapter in this session.

Call this when the work shifts to a meaningfully different phase — e.g. after finishing exploration and starting implementation, after a fix lands and you move to verification, or when the user pivots to an unrelated request. The user sees a divider in the transcript and a floating table of contents for jumping between chapters.

Use sparingly: a chapter should cover a coherent stretch of work, not every tool call. A typical session has 3–8 chapters. Do not mark a chapter for the very first message — the session start is implicit.

The title is a short noun phrase ("Codebase exploration", "Auth bug fix", "Test verification"), not a sentence.

Flag an out-of-scope issue for a separate background task.

Call this when you notice something worth fixing that would bloat the current change — dead code, stale docs, missing coverage, a confirmed TODO, or a security issue spotted in passing. Don't flag vague code-smell observations, trivial fixes you can do inline, or low-confidence hunches. A chip appears for the user; one click spins it off into its own session. The prompt must stand alone — include file paths and enough context to act without this conversation.

The result includes a task_id; call dismiss_task with it if the suggestion later becomes stale.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__browser_batch
tools.description: Execute a sequence of Browser pane tool calls in ONE round trip. Each item is {name, input} where input is exactly what you'd pass to that tool standalone. Actions execute SEQUENTIALLY (not in parallel) and stop on the first error. Use this tool extensively to quickly execute work whenever you can predict two or more steps ahead — e.g. navigate, click a field, type, press Return, screenshot. Each tool's own permission check runs per item — a step on a site the user hasn't allowed either asks the user inline (and continues if they allow) or is refused, which stops the batch; if a step is refused for a missing permission, call that tool on its own (that call can ask the user), then batch the rest. Screenshots and other images are returned interleaved with outputs; coordinates you write in THIS batch refer to the screenshot taken BEFORE this call. browser_batch cannot be nested, and preview_start is not batchable — but if the Browser pane isn't open yet, a batch whose FIRST action is navigate with a url opens it (other actions still need an open page).

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
tools.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

schema.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
schema.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

tabId.description: Tab to act on within the preview context. Omit for the fronted tab; get ids from tabs_context.

action.description:
The action to perform:
* `left_click`: Click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `right_click`: Click the right mouse button at the specified coordinates to open context menus.
* `double_click`: Double-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `triple_click`: Triple-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `type`: Type a string of text.
* `screenshot`: Take a screenshot of the screen.
* `wait`: Wait for a specified number of seconds.
* `scroll`: Scroll up, down, left, or right at the specified coordinates.
* `key`: Press a specific keyboard key.
* `left_click_drag`: Drag from start_coordinate to coordinate.
* `zoom`: Take a screenshot of a specific region for closer inspection.
* `scroll_to`: Scroll an element into view using its element reference ID from read_page or find tools.
* `hover`: Move the mouse cursor to the specified coordinates or element without clicking. Useful for revealing tooltips, dropdown menus, or triggering hover states.

coordinate.description: (x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates. Required for `left_click`, `right_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, and `scroll`. For `left_click_drag`, this is the end position.

text.description: The text to type (for `type` action) or the key(s) to press (for `key` action). For `key` action: Provide space-separated keys (e.g., "Backspace Backspace Delete"). Supports keyboard shortcuts using the platform's modifier key (use "cmd" on Mac, "ctrl" on Windows/Linux, e.g., "cmd+a" or "ctrl+a" for select all). Page zoom shortcuts (e.g. "cmd+=", "ctrl+-", "cmd+0") are not supported - use the `zoom` action to magnify a region of the page instead.

duration.description: The number of seconds to wait. Required for `wait`. Maximum 10 seconds.

scroll_direction.description: The direction to scroll. Required for `scroll`.

scroll_amount.description: The number of scroll wheel ticks. Optional for `scroll`, defaults to 3.

region.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1): The rectangular region to capture for `zoom`. Coordinates define a rectangle from top-left (x0, y0) to bottom-right (x1, y1) in pixels from the viewport origin. Required for `zoom` action. Useful for inspecting small UI elements like icons, buttons, or text.

scale.description: For `screenshot` and `zoom` only. Scale factor in [0.1, 1] for the returned image; 1 (default) uses the full image token budget, 0.5 returns an image at half the width and height (~quarter of the tokens). Coordinates are ALWAYS in the full-resolution coordinate frame (reported with every scaled screenshot), never in the scaled image's own pixels.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the key sequence. Only applicable for `key` action. Must be a positive integer between 1 and 100. Default is 1. Useful for navigation tasks like pressing arrow keys multiple times.

ref.description: Element reference ID from read_page or find tools (e.g., "ref_1", "ref_2"). Required for `scroll_to` action. Can be used as alternative to `coordinate` for click actions.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys for click actions. Supports: "ctrl", "shift", "alt", "cmd" (or "meta"), "win" (or "windows"). Can be combined with "+" (e.g., "ctrl+shift", "cmd+alt"). Optional.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__resize_window
tools.description: Emulate a viewport size in the Browser pane tab. Presets: mobile (375x812), tablet (768x1024), or desktop, which clears the size emulation and returns the tab to the pane's own responsive size. Custom sizes need both width and height. An emulated size applies to that tab across reloads and navigation (scaled down to fit when it is larger than the pane): reset it with preset "desktop" as soon as you finish testing. The desktop app may also clear a size you set when your turn ends, so set it again in a later turn if you still need it. A size the user picked from the pane's own Viewport menu is theirs and stays until they or you change it; leave it unless they ask. colorScheme (light/dark) emulates prefers-color-scheme on that tab; it survives reloads and preset "desktop" does not touch it, but the pane re-syncs the tab to the app's light/dark theme when that theme changes or the pane reopens; local documents and static HTML previews always render light. The mobile preset (and any width < 768) also emulates a mobile device: Android Chrome user agent and 5 touch points, so pages detect a touch phone; your clicks still arrive as mouse clicks. Reload the page after switching so load-time device gates re-run.

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
===================================================================
   uXBasic PAKETLEYICI 3.1 - RAG MASTER ORCHESTRATOR
===================================================================
Mimar: Zühtü Mete Dinler & Gemini PRO
Sürüm: 3.1 (Modüler Analiz Motoru Entegre)

Bu program, FreeBasic (.fbs) kaynak kodlarını analiz eden,
paketleyen ve RAG/LLM sistemleri için veri hazırlayan ana orchestrator'dır.
"""

import os
import re
import sys
import json
import argparse
import importlib
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Set, Optional
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

# ============================================================================
# YARDIMCI MODÜLLER (IMPORT EDİLECEK)
# ============================================================================

def modulleri_import_et():
    """Gerekli modülleri dinamik olarak import et.

    Eski sürüm `moduller.*` adlı küçük harfli paket bekliyordu; bu zip içinde
    klasör adı `Moduller` ve statik analiz dosyası `StatikAnalizator.py`.
    Bu düzeltme script doğrudan `tools/Moduller` içinden de, paket kökünden de
    çalışınca importların bozulmamasını sağlar.
    """
    try:
        from StatikAnalizator import statik_analiz_yap
        from DavranissalAnalizor import davranissal_analiz_yap
        from CLIAnalizor import cli_analiz_yap
        from TopolojikAnalizor import topolojik_analiz_yap
        from KaliteAnalizor import kalite_analiz_yap
        from GuvenlikAnalizor import guvenlik_analiz_yap
        from RAGVeriHazirlayici import rag_verisi_hazirla
    except ImportError:
        try:
            from .StatikAnalizator import statik_analiz_yap
            from .DavranissalAnalizor import davranissal_analiz_yap
            from .CLIAnalizor import cli_analiz_yap
            from .TopolojikAnalizor import topolojik_analiz_yap
            from .KaliteAnalizor import kalite_analiz_yap
            from .GuvenlikAnalizor import guvenlik_analiz_yap
            from .RAGVeriHazirlayici import rag_verisi_hazirla
        except ImportError as e:
            print(f"[UYARI] Modül import hatası: {e}")
            print("[BİLGİ] Bazı analiz modülleri çalışmayabilir.")
            return None
    return {
        'statik': statik_analiz_yap,
        'davranissal': davranissal_analiz_yap,
        'cli': cli_analiz_yap,
        'topolojik': topolojik_analiz_yap,

1	# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
2	# =============================================================================
3	# V4 YORUMLU NOT: SYMBOL INDEX
4	# Büyük harfli keywordleri, TOKEN_/NODE_/MIR_ sembollerini ve parse_/emit_
5	# fonksiyonlarını tarar. Varsayılan index/symbol_index.json mini sembol atlasıdır.
6	# =============================================================================
7	from __future__ import annotations
8	import argparse, re
9	from collections import defaultdict
10	from uxb_common import load_config, iter_source_files, read_text_file, detect_layer, rel_to_root, safe_json_dump, abs_from_root, now_stamp
11	SYMBOL_RE=re.compile(r'\b[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{2,}\b|\b(?:TOKEN|NODE|AST|MIR|OP|KW)_[A-Za-z0-9_]+\b|\b(?:parse|emit|visit|scan|lex|build|gen|lower)_[A-Za-z0-9_]+\b', re.IGNORECASE)
12	
13	def scan_symbols(config_path: str) -> None:
14	    cfg=load_config(config_path); index=defaultdict(list)
15	    if cfg.get('symbol_source_roots'):
16	        cfg=dict(cfg)
17	        cfg['source_roots']=cfg.get('symbol_source_roots')
18	    for p in iter_source_files(cfg):
19	        try: text=read_text_file(p)
20	        except Exception: continue
21	        layer=detect_layer(cfg,p,text); rel=rel_to_root(cfg,p)
22	        for line_no,line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), start=1):
23	            for m in SYMBOL_RE.finditer(line):
24	                sym=m.group(0)
25	                if len(index[sym])<10: index[sym].append({'file':rel,'line':line_no,'layer':layer,'text':line[:150]})
26	    out_path=abs_from_root(cfg,cfg.get('symbol_index_path','index/symbol_index.json'))
27	    safe_json_dump(out_path, {'created_at':now_stamp(),'symbol_count':len(index),'symbols':dict(sorted(index.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[0]))})
28	    print(f'{out_path.name} yazıldı. Sembol sayısı: {len(index)}')
29	
30	def main():
31	    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument('--config',default='config.json'); args=ap.parse_args(); scan_symbols(args.config)
32	if __name__=='__main__': main()
33

1	# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
2	# =============================================================================
3	# V4 YORUMLU NOT: ORTAK ALT YAPI
4	# Bu modül config okuma, dosya tarama, dosya okuma, chunk üretme ve katman
5	# tahmini gibi bütün araçların ortak kullandığı fonksiyonları içerir.
6	# cfg: dict; config.json ayarlarıdır. Path: pathlib.Path dosya/klasör yoludur.
7	# Chunk sözlüğü: text, line_start, line_end, char_start, char_end alanlarını taşır.
8	# =============================================================================
9	from __future__ import annotations
10	import json, re, time, hashlib, fnmatch
11	from pathlib import Path
12	from typing import Dict, Iterable, List, Any
13	
14	TEXT_EXTENSIONS_DEFAULT = {'.bas','.bi','.inc','.c','.cpp','.h','.hpp','.asm','.s','.nasm','.js','.ts','.html','.css','.py','.ps1','.bat','.cmd','.md','.txt','.json','.csv','.log'}
15	
16	def load_config(config_path: str | Path = 'config.json') -> Dict[str, Any]:
17	    p = Path(config_path).resolve()
18	    if not p.exists():
19	        raise FileNotFoundError(f'Config bulunamadı: {p}')
20	    cfg = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
21	    cfg['_config_path'] = str(p)
22	    cfg['_root'] = str(p.parent)
23	    return cfg
24	
25	def abs_from_root(cfg: Dict[str, Any], path_value: str | Path) -> Path:
26	    p = Path(path_value)
27	    return p if p.is_absolute() else Path(cfg['_root']) / p
28	
29	def rel_to_root(cfg: Dict[str, Any], path_value: str | Path) -> str:
30	    p = Path(path_value).resolve(); root = Path(cfg['_root']).resolve()
31	    try: return str(p.relative_to(root)).replace('\\','/')
32	    except ValueError: return str(p).replace('\\','/')
33	
34	def ensure_dirs(cfg: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
35	    abs_from_root(cfg, cfg.get('chroma_path','index/chroma_db')).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
36	    (Path(cfg['_root'])/'index').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
37	    (Path(cfg['_root'])/'logs').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
38	
39	def is_excluded(path: Path, exclude_dirs: List[str]) -> bool:
40	    parts = {x.lower() for x in path.parts}
41	    return any(x.lower() in parts for x in exclude_dirs)
42	
43	def iter_source_files(cfg: Dict[str, Any]) -> Iterable[Path]:
44	    roots = cfg.get('source_roots') or ['kaynaklar']
45	    supported = {x.lower() for x in cfg.get('supported_extensions', list(TEXT_EXTENSIONS_DEFAULT))}
46	    exclude = cfg.get('exclude_dirs', [])
47	    exclude_file_globs = cfg.get('exclude_file_globs', [])
48	    for rv in roots:
49	        rp = abs_from_root(cfg, rv)
50	        if not rp.exists(): continue
51	        for p in rp.rglob('*'):
52	            if not p.is_file():
53	                continue
54	            if is_excluded(p, exclude):
55	                continue
56	            if p.suffix.lower() not in supported:
57	                continue
58	            if any(fnmatch.fnmatch(p.name, pat) for pat in exclude_file_globs):
59	                continue
60	            name_l = p.name.lower()
61	            if name_l.startswith('buraya_') or 'placeholder' in name_l or 'kopyala' in name_l:
62	                continue
63	            yield p
64	
65	def read_text_file(path: Path) -> str:
66	    for enc in ('utf-8-sig','utf-8','cp1254','cp1252','latin-1'):
67	        try: return path.read_text(encoding=enc, errors='strict')
68	        except UnicodeDecodeError: pass
69	        except Exception: break
70	    return path.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
71	
72	def sha1_text(text: str) -> str:
73	    return hashlib.sha1(text.encode('utf-8', errors='ignore')).hexdigest()
74	
75	def detect_language_by_ext(path: Path) -> str:
76	    return {'.bas':'freebasic/basic','.bi':'freebasic_header','.inc':'include','.c':'c','.cpp':'cpp','.h':'c_header','.hpp':'cpp_header','.asm':'asm','.s':'asm','.nasm':'nasm','.js':'javascript','.ts':'typescript','.html':'html','.css':'css','.py':'python','.ps1':'powershell','.bat':'batch','.cmd':'batch','.md':'markdown','.txt':'text','.json':'json','.csv':'csv','.log':'log'}.get(path.suffix.lower(),'text')
77	
78	def detect_layer(cfg: Dict[str, Any], path: Path, text_hint: str = '') -> str:
79	    joined = (rel_to_root(cfg,path)+'\n'+text_hint[:1000]).lower()
80	    rules = cfg.get('layer_path_rules', {})
81	    for layer in cfg.get('layer_order', []):
82	        if any(term.lower() in joined for term in rules.get(layer, [])):
83	            return layer
84	    return 'unknown'
85	
86	def line_number_at_offset(text: str, offset: int) -> int:
87	    return text.count('\n', 0, max(0, offset)) + 1
88	
89	def make_chunks(cfg: Dict[str, Any], path: Path, text: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
90	    chunk_chars = max(500, int(cfg.get('chunk_chars',1800)))
91	    overlap = max(0, int(cfg.get('chunk_overlap',250)))
92	    if overlap >= chunk_chars: overlap = chunk_chars // 5
93	    chunks=[]; n=len(text); start=0; idx=0
94	    while start < n:
95	        end = min(n, start + chunk_chars)
96	        if end < n:
97	            nl = text.find('\n', end, min(n, end+250))
98	            if nl != -1: end = nl + 1
99	        piece = text[start:end].strip()
100	        if piece:
101	            chunks.append({'chunk_index':idx,'text':piece,'line_start':line_number_at_offset(text,start),'line_end':line_number_at_offset(text,end),'char_start':start,'char_end':end})
102	            idx += 1
103	        if end >= n: break
104	        start = max(0, end - overlap)
105	    return chunks
106	
107	def safe_json_dump(path: Path, data: Any) -> None:
108	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
109	    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
110	
111	def now_stamp() -> str:
112	    return time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')

/**
 * @file FreeBasic grammar for tree-sitter
 * @author Ra77a3l3-jar <raffaelemeo77@gmail.com>
 * @license MIT
 */

/// <reference types="tree-sitter-cli/dsl" />

const PREC = {
  DEFAULT: 0,
  LOGICAL_OR: 1,
  LOGICAL_AND: 2,
  LOGICAL_NOT: 3,
  RELATIONAL: 4,
  ADD: 5,
  MULTIPLY: 6,
  UNARY: 7,
  POWER: 8,
  CALL: 9,
  MEMBER: 10,
};

module.exports = grammar({
  name: 'freebasic',

  extras: $ => [
    /\s/,
    $.comment,
  ],

  word: $ => $.identifier,

  conflicts: $ => [
    [$.return_statement],
    [$.print_statement],
    [$.for_statement],
  ],

  rules: {
    source_file: $ => repeat($._statement),

    _statement: $ => choice(
      $.dim_statement,
      $.assignment_statement,
      $.if_statement,
      $.while_statement,
      $.for_statement,
      $.do_statement,
      $.sub_declaration,
      $.function_declaration,
      $.return_statement,
      $.print_statement,
      $.input_statement,
      $.sleep_statement,
      $.call_statement,
      $.comment,
    ),

    dim_statement: $ => seq(
      field('keyword', alias(/[Dd][Ii][Mm]/, 'DIM')),
      field('name', $.identifier),
      optional(seq(
        alias(/[Aa][Ss]/, 'AS'),
        field('type', $.type_identifier)
      )),
      optional(seq(
        '=',
        field('value', $.expression)
      ))
    ),

    assignment_statement: $ => seq(
      field('left', $.identifier),
      '=',
      field('right', $.expression)
    ),

    if_statement: $ => seq(
      field('keyword', alias(/[Ii][Ff]/, 'IF')),
      field('condition', $.expression),
      alias(/[Tt][Hh][Ee][Nn]/, 'THEN'),
      repeat($._statement),
      optional(seq(
        alias(/[Ee][Ll][Ss][Ee]/, 'ELSE'),
        repeat($._statement)
      )),
      alias(/[Ee][Nn][Dd]\s+[Ii][Ff]/, 'END IF')
    ),

    while_statement: $ => seq(
      alias(/[Ww][Hh][Ii][Ll][Ee]/, 'WHILE'),
      field('condition', $.expression),
      repeat($._statement),
      alias(/[Ww][Ee][Nn][Dd]/, 'WEND')
    ),

    for_statement: $ => seq(
      alias(/[Ff][Oo][Rr]/, 'FOR'),
      field('variable', $.identifier),
      '=',
      field('start', $.expression),
      alias(/[Tt][Oo]/, 'TO'),
      field('end', $.expression),
      optional(seq(
        alias(/[Ss][Tt][Ee][Pp]/, 'STEP'),
        field('step', $.expression)
      )),
      repeat($._statement),
      alias(/[Nn][Ee][Xx][Tt]/, 'NEXT'),
      optional($.identifier)
    ),

    do_statement: $ => seq(
      alias(/[Dd][Oo]/, 'DO'),
      repeat($._statement),
      alias(/[Ll][Oo][Oo][Pp]/, 'LOOP'),
      optional(seq(
        alias(/[Uu][Nn][Tt][Ii][Ll]/, 'UNTIL'),
        field('condition', $.expression)
      ))
    ),

    sub_declaration: $ => seq(
      alias(/[Ss][Uu][Bb]/, 'SUB'),
      field('name', $.identifier),
      '(',
      optional($.parameter_list),
      ')',
      repeat($._statement),
      alias(/[Ee][Nn][Dd]\s+[Ss][Uu][Bb]/, 'END SUB')
    ),

    function_declaration: $ => seq(
      alias(/[Ff][Uu][Nn][Cc][Tt][Ii][Oo][Nn]/, 'FUNCTION'),
      field('name', $.identifier),
      '(',
      optional($.parameter_list),
      ')',
      optional(seq(
        alias(/[Aa][Ss]/, 'AS'),
        field('return_type', $.type_identifier)
      )),
      repeat($._statement),
      alias(/[Ee][Nn][Dd]\s+[Ff][Uu][Nn][Cc][Tt][Ii][Oo][Nn]/, 'END FUNCTION')
    ),

    parameter_list: $ => sep1($.parameter, ','),

    parameter: $ => seq(
      field('name', $.identifier),
      optional(seq(
        alias(/[Aa][Ss]/, 'AS'),
        field('type', $.type_identifier)
      ))
    ),

    return_statement: $ => seq(
      alias(/[Rr][Ee][Tt][Uu][Rr][Nn]/, 'RETURN'),
      optional($.expression)
    ),

    print_statement: $ => seq(
      alias(/[Pp][Rr][Ii][Nn][Tt]/, 'PRINT'),
      optional(sep1($.expression, choice(',', ';')))
    ),

    input_statement: $ => seq(
      alias(/[Ii][Nn][Pp][Uu][Tt]/, 'INPUT'),
      optional(seq(
        $.string_literal,
        choice(',', ';')
      )),
      $.identifier
    ),

    sleep_statement: $ => alias(/[Ss][Ll][Ee][Ee][Pp]/, 'SLEEP'),

    call_statement: $ => $.call_expression,

    expression: $ => choice(
      $.binary_expression,
      $.unary_expression,
      $.call_expression,
      $.parenthesized_expression,
      $.identifier,
      $.number_literal,
      $.string_literal,
    ),

    binary_expression: $ => choice(
      prec.left(PREC.LOGICAL_OR, seq(
        field('left', $.expression),
        field('operator', alias(/[Oo][Rr]/, 'OR')),
        field('right', $.expression)
      )),
      prec.left(PREC.LOGICAL_AND, seq(
        field('left', $.expression),
        field('operator', alias(/[Aa][Nn][Dd]/, 'AND')),

import ctypes, re, sys, random, time
from pathlib import Path
from tree_sitter import Language, Parser

BASE = Path(r"C:\Users\mete\Downloads\BasicOyunSource\UXBc_Clean\UXBc\UxbRAG\UXB_HYBRID_RAG_V4_YORUMLU_JSON\tools\uxb_map")

lib = ctypes.cdll.LoadLibrary(str(BASE / "freebasic.dll"))
lib.tree_sitter_freebasic.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
lang = Language(lib.tree_sitter_freebasic())
parser = Parser(lang)

EXT = {".bas", ".bi", ".fbs", ".fb"}
files = []
for sub in ("src", "include", "libsx", "runtime_ext", "compiler"):
    d = UXB / sub
    if d.exists():
        files += [p for p in d.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and p.suffix.lower() in EXT]
random.seed(1)
random.shuffle(files)
files = files[:int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 200]

DECL_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:private\s+|public\s+)?(function|sub)\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)", re.I | re.M)

def err_bytes(node):
    tot = 0
    stack = [node]
    while stack:
        n = stack.pop()
        if n.type == "ERROR" or n.is_missing:
            tot += max(1, n.end_byte - n.start_byte)
        elif n.has_error:
            stack.extend(n.children)
    return tot

def count_decls(node):
    c = 0
    stack = [node]
    while stack:
        n = stack.pop()
        if n.type in ("function_declaration", "sub_declaration"):
            c += 1
        stack.extend(n.children)
    return c

tot_bytes = tot_err = 0
gt_decls = ts_decls = 0
files_with_err = 0
t0 = time.time()
for p in files:
    try:
        raw = p.read_bytes()
    except Exception:
        continue
    try:
        txt = raw.decode("utf-8")
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        txt = raw.decode("cp1254", errors="replace")
        raw = txt.encode("utf-8")
    tree = parser.parse(raw)
    e = err_bytes(tree.root_node)
    tot_bytes += len(raw)
    tot_err += e
    if e:
        files_with_err += 1
    gt = len([m for m in DECL_RE.finditer(txt) if not re.match(r"\s*declare", txt[max(0, m.start()-0):m.start()+8], re.I)])
    gt_decls += gt
    ts_decls += count_decls(tree.root_node)

print(f"dosya: {len(files)}  hata iceren dosya: {files_with_err} (%{100*files_with_err/max(1,len(files)):.1f})")
print(f"toplam bayt: {tot_bytes}  ERROR/MISSING bayt: {tot_err} (%{100*tot_err/max(1,tot_bytes):.1f})")
print(f"regex ground-truth FUNCTION/SUB: {gt_decls}   tree-sitter bulduğu: {ts_decls}  (%{100*ts_decls/max(1,gt_decls):.1f})")
print(f"sure: {time.time()-t0:.1f} sn")

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import json, re, os
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict

tmp = Path(os.environ["TEMP"]) / "ct_out.json"
UXB = Path(r"C:\Users\mete\Downloads\BasicOyunSource\UXBc_Clean\UXBc\uxb")
EXT = {".bas", ".bi", ".fbs", ".fb"}

ct = defaultdict(set)      # dosya -> {isim(lower)} (function kind)
seen = set()
for ln in tmp.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines():
    try:
        t = json.loads(ln)
    except Exception:
        continue
    if t.get("kind") != "function":
        continue
    key = (t["path"], t["name"], t.get("line"))
    if key in seen:
        continue
    seen.add(key)
    ct[str(Path(t["path"]).resolve()).lower()].add(t["name"].lower())

DEF_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:(?:private|public|static)\s+)*(function|sub)\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)", re.I | re.M)
DECL_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*declare\s+(function|sub)\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)", re.I | re.M)

gt_total = hit = 0
ct_total = ct_ok = 0
miss_examples = []
extra_examples = []
for sub in ("src", "include", "libsx", "runtime_ext", "compiler"):
    d = UXB / sub
    if not d.exists():
        continue
    for p in d.rglob("*"):
        if not p.is_file() or p.suffix.lower() not in EXT:
            continue
        try:
            txt = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        except Exception:
            continue
        defs = {m.group(2).lower() for m in DEF_RE.finditer(txt)}
        decls = {m.group(2).lower() for m in DECL_RE.finditer(txt)}
        got = ct.get(str(p.resolve()).lower(), set())
        gt_total += len(defs)
        hit += len(defs & got)
        if defs - got and len(miss_examples) < 8:
            miss_examples.append((p.name, sorted(defs - got)[:3]))
        ct_total += len(got)
        ok = got & (defs | decls)
        ct_ok += len(ok)
        if got - (defs | decls) and len(extra_examples) < 8:
            extra_examples.append((p.name, sorted(got - (defs | decls))[:3]))

print(f"GT (regex tanim) isim sayisi: {gt_total}")
print(f"ctags recall  : {hit}/{gt_total} = %{100*hit/max(1,gt_total):.1f}")
print(f"ctags precision: {ct_ok}/{ct_total} = %{100*ct_ok/max(1,ct_total):.1f}")
print("kacirilan ornek:", miss_examples)
print("fazla ornek   :", extra_examples)

---
name: uxb-map-tooling-evaluation-2026-09-19
description: Measured verdicts on tree-sitter-freebasic, ctags, Codex map inventory and RAG embedding speed for the UXBc low-token map effort
metadata:
  type: project
---

2026-09-19 ölçümleri (UxbRAG V4 altında, gerçek `uxb/src|include|libsx|runtime_ext|compiler` kaynaklarıyla):

- **tree-sitter-freebasic (Ra77a3l3-jar, 6 KB oyuncak gramer) kullanılamaz**: 200/200 dosyada hata, baytların %90'ı ERROR. TYPE/DECLARE/#include/SELECT CASE/dizi/üye erişimi yok. Hazır `tree-sitter-language-pack`'te de FreeBASIC yok. Derlenmiş kopya `UxbRAG/.../tools/uxb_map/` içinde (freebasic.dll + .venv), silinmedi.
- **Universal ctags 6.1.0 `Basic` ayrıştırıcısı** (C:\Program Files\CodeBlocks\MinGW\bin) FreeBASIC'i okuyor; `--langmap=Basic:+.fbs`. Codex'in `uxb_map_system.py` envanteriyle (dosya,isim) bazında ~%96-98 örtüşüyor (6032 ortak). Bağımsız doğrulayıcı olarak kullanılabilir, omurga değil (Codex koleksiyoncusu parametre/dönüş/TYPE alanı/yorum da çıkarıyor).
- **Asıl eksik: "amaç" alanı** — 6403 fonksiyon/sub/metotun yalnızca %4.5'inde `purpose` dolu (girdi %90, çıktı %97 dolu). Amaç bir parser'la çıkmaz; LLM ile, devam ettirilebilir (checkpoint'li) toplu iş gerekir.
- **RAG vektörleştirme darboğazı**: core profil 2444 dosya = 39.092 chunk; `nomic-embed-text` ~1 chunk/sn (≈11 saat), `all-minilm` ~12.6 chunk/sn (≈52 dk). `uxb/compiler/wrappers/uxb_main_wrapper.c` (23 MB üretilmiş C) tek başına 16.491 chunk üretiyor; `docs` 13.700 chunk.
- `index/symbol_index_core.json` 80 MB (eski: 270 MB): kaba büyük-harf-kelime indeksi, gerçek sembol tablosu değil; gerçek sorgu için Codex'in `reports/uxb_map_system/<tarih>/symbol_inventory.json` + `tools/uxb_map_lookup.py` kullanılmalı.

**Why:** Kullanıcı aynı envanter işini defalarca yarım bıraktığından, hangi aracın gerçekten işe yaradığını ölçümle bilmek gerekiyor; tekrar tree-sitter/regex denemesi yapılmasın.
**How to apply:** Harita/indeks önerirken bu sayılara dayan; "amaç/görev" doldurmak için LLM'li resumable pipeline öner, yeni parser yazmayı önerme.

Tree-sitter FreeBASIC'i kurdum ve ölçtüm: bu proje için kullanılamaz. Kaynak koda ve Codex'in dosyalarına dokunmadım; yalnızca `tools/uxb_map/` altına kendi denemelerimi ekledim.

## Ölçüm sonuçları

| Konu | Sonuç |
|---|---|
| **tree-sitter-freebasic** | Gramer 6 KB'lık öğretici seviyesinde; `TYPE`, `DECLARE`, `#include`, `SELECT CASE`, dizi ve üye erişimi yok. 64-bit clang ile derledim, 200 gerçek dosyanın 200'ünde hata çıktı, baytların %90'ı `ERROR`. Hazır tree-sitter paketinde FreeBASIC hiç yok. |
| **ctags** | Makinedeki Universal Ctags 6.1.0 FreeBASIC'i okuyor. Codex'in envanteriyle aynı yerlerde ~%96-98 örtüşüyor (6.032 ortak fonksiyon/sub). Bu, iki aracın da satır-regex mantığıyla çalışması yüzünden tam bağımsız bir doğrulama sayılmaz. |
| **Codex haritası** | Yapı iyi: girdi %90, çıktı %97 dolu. **Amaç/görev alanı yalnızca %4,5 dolu** (6.403 fonksiyonun 291'i). |
| **RAG yavaşlığı** | Core profil 39.092 chunk. `nomic-embed-text` saniyede ~1 chunk (≈11 saat), `all-minilm` ~12,6 chunk (≈52 dk). |
| **Şişme nedeni** | `uxb/compiler/wrappers/uxb_main_wrapper.c` (23 MB üretilmiş C) tek başına 16.491 chunk üretiyor. |

`symbol_source_roots` düzenlemesi de tamamlanmıştı; çalıştırınca core sembol taraması bitti ve `symbol_index_core.json` 80 MB çıktı. O dosya gerçek bir sembol tablosu değil, büyük harfli kelimelerin kaba listesi. Asıl sorgu Codex'in `symbol_inventory.json` ve `uxb_map_lookup.py` dosyalarıyla yapılmalı.

## Öneri

1. **Tree-sitter'ı bırak, yeni parser yazma.** Kod yapısı zaten çıkıyor; eksik olan "bu fonksiyon ne işe yarar" bilgisi, ve o bir parser'la değil ancak kodu okuyan bir modelle üretilir. Senin defalarca yarım kalan işin tam olarak bu. Çözümü, her fonksiyon için tek cümlelik Türkçe amaç üreten, kaldığı yerden devam eden ve kod değişmediyse atlayan bir toplu iş yapmak.
2. **RAG'ı daralt.** Kod aramasını sembol haritası ve `rg` üstlemeli; vektörleme yalnızca `docs`, `ai_koordinasyon` ve kararlar için kullanılmalı. `uxb_main_wrapper.c` hariç tutulmalı.

Amaç cümlelerini kimin üreteceğini sen seçmelisin:
- **Yerel Ollama (`qwen2.5:3b` / `qwen2.5-coder:3b`)**: bedava ama yavaş, Türkçe ve uXBasic kalitesi orta. 6.100 fonksiyon için birkaç saat sürer.
- **Claude alt ajanları**: daha kaliteli ve hızlı ama token harcar; hedefin "az token" olduğu için bunu kendin tartmalısın.

Ben yerel Ollama ile başlayıp örnek 50 fonksiyonda kaliteye bakmayı ve iyi çıkarsa tümüne yaymayı öneriyorum. Hangisini istersin, ve `compiler` hariç tutma ile "vektör yalnızca dokümanlar" kararını onaylıyor musun?

def paketleyici():
    root_dir, max_size_limit, target_dir = argumanlari_ve_klasoru_ayarla()

    paketler_dir = os.path.join(target_dir, "paketler")
    envanter_dir = os.path.join(target_dir, "envanter")
    os.makedirs(paketler_dir, exist_ok=True)
    os.makedirs(envanter_dir, exist_ok=True)

    print(f"\n[BAŞLADI] Gelişimsel analiz katmanları yükleniyor. Kaynak: {root_dir}")
    print(f"[AYAR] Hedef Paket Üst Sınırı: {max_size_limit / 1024} KB")
    print(f"[ÇIKTI] Hedef Klasör: {target_dir}\n")

    all_files = []
    for current_path, _, filenames in os.walk(root_dir):
        if "tekdosyaklsoru" in current_path:
            continue

        for filename in filenames:
            if filename.lower().endswith(".fbs"):
                full_path = os.path.join(current_path, filename)
                file_size = os.path.getsize(full_path)
                rel_folder = os.path.relpath(current_path, root_dir)
                if rel_folder == ".":
                    rel_folder = ""

                all_files.append({
                    "full_path": full_path,
                    "folder_name": rel_folder,
                    "file_name": filename,
                    "file_size": file_size,
                })

    total_file_count = len(all_files)
    if total_file_count == 0:
        print("[HATA] Klasörde paketlenecek .fbs uzantılı dosya bulunamadı!")
        return

    harita_path = os.path.join(target_dir, "harita_fiziksel.txt")
    with open(harita_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f_harita:
        f_harita.write("Klasor | Dosya Adi | Boyut (Bayt) | Tam Yol\n")
        f_harita.write("-" * 60 + "\n")
        for file in all_files:
            f_harita.write(f"{file['folder_name']} | {file['file_name']} | {file['file_size']} | {file['full_path']}\n")

    folder_counts = {}
    for file in all_files:
        f_dir = file["folder_name"]
        folder_counts[f_dir] = folder_counts.get(f_dir, 0) + 1

    folder_current_indices = {}
    current_file_idx = 0
    current_chunk_no = 1
    envanter_path = os.path.join(envanter_dir, "envanter_index.txt")

    with open(envanter_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f_envanter:
        while current_file_idx < total_file_count:
            chunk_name = f"{current_chunk_no:02d}_src.txt"
            chunk_path = os.path.join(paketler_dir, chunk_name)
            current_chunk_size = 0

            with open(chunk_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f_out:
                while current_file_idx < total_file_count:
                    file = all_files[current_file_idx]
                    f_size = file["file_size"]

                    if (current_chunk_size + f_size + 300 > max_size_limit) and current_chunk_size > 0:
                        break

                    f_dir = file["folder_name"]
                    folder_current_indices[f_dir] = folder_current_indices.get(f_dir, 0) + 1

                    modul_no = folder_current_indices[f_dir]
                    klasordeki_toplam = folder_counts[f_dir]

                    header = (
                        "=========================================================\n"
                        f"📄 MODÜL: {file['file_name']}   [{modul_no} / {klasordeki_toplam} | Sistem Toplam: {total_file_count}]\n"
                        "=========================================================\n"
                    )

                    f_out.write(header)
                    current_chunk_size += len(header.encode("utf-8"))

                    try:
                        with open(file["full_path"], "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f_in:
                            content = f_in.read()
                            f_out.write(content)
                            current_chunk_size += len(content.encode("utf-8"))
                    except Exception as e:
                        error_msg = f"[HATA: Dosya okunamadı! - {str(e)}]"
                        f_out.write(error_msg)
                        current_chunk_size += len(error_msg.encode("utf-8"))

                    f_out.write("\n\n")
                    current_chunk_size += 2

                    f_envanter.write(f"{file['file_name']} -> paketler/{chunk_name}\n")
                    current_file_idx += 1

            current_chunk_no += 1

    print("-> harita_fiziksel.txt ve kaynak paketleri başarıyla oluşturuldu.")
    baglilik_analizi(all_files, root_dir, target_dir)
    print("\n[BAŞARI] Gelişimsel analiz motoru (GelisimselAnalizor.py) RAG MASTER dökümantasyonunu mükemmel şekilde tamamladı.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    paketleyici()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
UXBc harita çıktılarını düşük-token biçimde sorgular.

Bu araç büyük JSON envanterlerini LLM'e komple vermek yerine yalnız istenen
sembolü veya dil yüzeyi maddesini küçük bir metin çıktısı olarak gösterir.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


SCRIPT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
WORKSPACE_ROOT = SCRIPT_DIR.parents[2]
LATEST_SUMMARY = WORKSPACE_ROOT / "reports" / "uxb_map_system" / "latest_summary.json"


def read_json(path: Path) -> Any:
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def latest_output_dir() -> Path:
    if not LATEST_SUMMARY.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"Son harita özeti bulunamadı: {LATEST_SUMMARY}")
    data = read_json(LATEST_SUMMARY)
    out_dir = Path(data["output_dir"])
    if not out_dir.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"Son harita çıktı dizini bulunamadı: {out_dir}")
    return out_dir


def short_purpose(item: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    text = str(item.get("purpose") or "").strip()
    return text if text else "-"


def print_symbol(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    out_dir = Path(args.out).resolve() if args.out else latest_output_dir()
    path = out_dir / "symbol_inventory.json"
    data = read_json(path)
    needle = args.name.upper()
    rows = data.get("by_name", {}).get(needle, [])
    if args.contains and not rows:
        rows = []
        for name, items in data.get("by_name", {}).items():
            if needle in name:
                rows.extend(items)
                if len(rows) >= args.limit:
                    break
    if args.kind:
        rows = [x for x in rows if str(x.get("kind", "")).upper() == args.kind.upper()]
    rows = rows[: args.limit]

    print(f"Aranan sembol: {args.name}")
    print(f"Harita dizini: {out_dir}")
    print(f"Bulunan kayıt: {len(rows)}")
    if not rows:
        print("Sonuç yok. Daha geniş arama için --contains veya rg kullan.")
        return 1

    for i, item in enumerate(rows, start=1):
        container = item.get("container") or "-"
        output = item.get("output") or "-"
        inputs = item.get("inputs") or []
        input_text = ", ".join(
            f"{x.get('mode', '').strip()} {x.get('name', '')}: {x.get('type', '')}".strip()
            for x in inputs
        ) or "-"
        print("")
        print(f"{i}. {item.get('kind', '-')}: {item.get('name', '-')}")
        print(f"   dosya: {item.get('file', '-')}:{item.get('line', '-')}")
        print(f"   kapsayıcı: {container}")
        print(f"   girdi: {input_text}")
        print(f"   çıktı/tip: {output}")
        print(f"   amaç/yorum: {short_purpose(item)}")
    return 0


def print_surface(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    out_dir = Path(args.out).resolve() if args.out else latest_output_dir()
    path = out_dir / "surface_inventory.json"
    data = read_json(path)
    needle = args.name.upper()
    tables = {
        "keywords": data.get("keywords", []),
        "preprocessor_commands": data.get("preprocessor_commands", {}),
        "operators": data.get("operators", {}),
        "types": data.get("types", {}),
        "data_structures": data.get("data_structures", {}),
        "builtin_candidates": data.get("builtin_candidates", {}),
    }

    print(f"Aranan dil yüzeyi: {args.name}")
    print(f"Harita dizini: {out_dir}")
    found = 0
    for table_name, table in tables.items():
        if args.category and table_name != args.category:
            continue
        if isinstance(table, list):
            matches = [x for x in table if (needle in x.upper() if args.contains else needle == x.upper())]
            for value in matches[: args.limit]:
                found += 1
                print("")
                print(f"- kategori: {table_name}")
                print(f"  ad: {value}")
        else:
            names = [x for x in table if (needle in x.upper() if args.contains else needle == x.upper())]
            for value in names[: args.limit]:
                found += 1
                print("")
                print(f"- kategori: {table_name}")
                print(f"  ad: {value}")
                for ref in table[value][:5]:
                    if "kind" in ref:
                        print(f"  örnek: {ref.get('kind')} {ref.get('file')}:{ref.get('line')}")
                    else:
                        print(f"  örnek: {ref.get('file')}:{ref.get('line')}")
    print("")
    print(f"Bulunan kategori kaydı: {found}")
    return 0 if found else 1


def print_summary(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    out_dir = Path(args.out).resolve() if args.out else latest_output_dir()
    path = out_dir / "UXBC_MAP_SUMMARY.md"
    print(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"))
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="UXBc harita çıktılarını küçük sonuçlarla sorgular.")
    parser.add_argument("--out", default="", help="Belirli bir harita çıktı dizini. Boşsa latest_summary.json kullanılır.")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    sym = sub.add_parser("symbol", help="Fonksiyon/sub/metot/sınıf/tip/alan adına göre ara.")
    sym.add_argument("name")
    sym.add_argument("--kind", default="")
    sym.add_argument("--contains", action="store_true")
    sym.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=20)
    sym.set_defaults(func=print_symbol)

    surf = sub.add_parser("surface", help="Lexer/preprocessor/operator/tip/veri yapısı yüzeyinde ara.")
    surf.add_argument("name")
    surf.add_argument("--category", choices=["keywords", "preprocessor_commands", "operators", "types", "data_structures", "builtin_candidates"], default="")
    surf.add_argument("--contains", action="store_true")
    surf.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=20)
    surf.set_defaults(func=print_surface)

    summ = sub.add_parser("summary", help="Son küçük harita özetini yazdır.")
    summ.set_defaults(func=print_summary)

    args = parser.parse_args()
    return args.func(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

        ctypes.windll.kernel32.SetPriorityClass(ctypes.windll.kernel32.GetCurrentProcess(), 0x4000)
    except Exception:
        pass


def load_inventory() -> tuple[list[dict], Path]:
    if not LATEST_SUMMARY.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"Harita özeti yok: {LATEST_SUMMARY}\nÖnce uxb_map_system.py çalıştırılmalı.")
    out_dir = Path(json.loads(LATEST_SUMMARY.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["output_dir"])
    inv = json.loads((out_dir / "symbol_inventory.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    rows: list[dict] = []
    seen: set[tuple] = set()
    for items in inv.get("by_name", {}).values():
        for it in items:
            if it.get("kind") not in ROUTINE_KINDS:
                continue
            k = (it["file"], it["line"], it["name"])
            if k in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(k)
            rows.append(it)
    return rows, out_dir


class SourceCache:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.files: dict[str, list[str] | None] = {}

    def lines(self, rel: str) -> list[str] | None:
        if rel not in self.files:
            p = WORKSPACE / rel
            try:
                self.files[rel] = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()
            except OSError:
                self.files[rel] = None
        return self.files[rel]


def extract_body(lines: list[str], line_no: int, name: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
    """('DECL', baslik) prototip için, ('DEF', govde) tanım için, None: kayıt eskimiş."""
    if line_no < 1 or line_no > len(lines):
        return None
    head = lines[line_no - 1]
    if name.lower() not in head.lower():
        return None
    if DECLARE_RE.match(head):
        return ("DECL", head.strip())
    end = None
    for j in range(line_no, min(len(lines), line_no + 600)):
        if END_RE.match(lines[j]):
            end = j
            break
    if end is None:
        end = min(len(lines) - 1, line_no + 60)
    return ("DEF", "\n".join(lines[line_no - 1 : end + 1]))


def shorten(body: str, limit: int = 1800) -> str:
    if len(body) <= limit:
        return body
    return body[:1300] + "\n' ... (orta kısım kısaltıldı) ...\n" + body[-400:]


def body_key(item: dict, body: str) -> str:
    norm = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", body).strip()
    raw = f"{item['file']}|{item['kind']}|{item.get('container','')}|{item['name']}|{norm}"
    return hashlib.sha1(raw.encode("utf-8", errors="ignore")).hexdigest()


def load_cache(path: Path) -> dict[str, dict]:
    out: dict[str, dict] = {}
    if not path.exists():
        return out
    with path.open(encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for ln in f:
            ln = ln.strip()
            if not ln:
                continue
            try:
                rec = json.loads(ln)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                continue
            out[rec["key"]] = rec
    return out


def ask_ollama(model: str, user_text: str, strict: bool = False) -> str:
    system = SYSTEM_PROMPT + ("\nÖNEMLİ: Cevap SADECE Türkçe olmalı, İngilizce kelime kullanma." if strict else "")
    payload = {
        "model": model,
        "stream": False,
        "keep_alive": "30m",
        "options": {"temperature": 0.1, "num_predict": 90, "num_ctx": 2048},
        "messages": [{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user_text}],
    }
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        OLLAMA_URL + "/api/chat",
        data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
    )
    last_err = None
    for _ in range(3):
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=600) as r:
                return json.load(r)["message"]["content"]
        except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, ConnectionError, KeyError) as e:
            last_err = e
            time.sleep(3)
    raise SystemExit(f"Ollama'ya ulaşılamadı ({last_err}). Ollama açık mı ve '{model}' yüklü mü?")


def clean_answer(text: str) -> str:
    text = text.strip().splitlines()[0].strip() if text.strip() else ""
    text = text.strip("`\"' ")
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
    return text[:240]


def looks_english(text: str) -> bool:
    words = [w.lower() for w in re.findall(r"[A-Za-z]+", text)]
    return sum(1 for w in words if w in EN_STOP) >= 2


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Rutinler için yerel modelle Türkçe amaç cümlesi üretir (devam edebilir).")
    ap.add_argument("--model", default=DEFAULT_MODEL)
    ap.add_argument("--cache", default=str(DEFAULT_CACHE))
    ap.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=0, help="Bu çalıştırmada en fazla kaç rutin (0 = sınırsız).")
    ap.add_argument("--max-minutes", type=float, default=0, help="Bu kadar dakika sonra kendiliğinden dur (0 = sınırsız).")
    ap.add_argument("--path-filter", default="", help="Yalnız yolu bu metni içeren dosyalar (örn. uxb/src/parser).")
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Model çağırmadan planı ve öncelik listesini göster.")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    raise_to_background_priority()
    rows, out_dir = load_inventory()
    src = SourceCache()
    cache_path = Path(args.cache)
    cache = load_cache(cache_path)

    tokens: Counter = Counter()
    for rel in sorted({r["file"] for r in rows}):
        lines = src.lines(rel)
        if lines:
            tokens.update(w.lower() for w in WORD_RE.findall("\n".join(lines)))

    todo: list[tuple[int, dict, str, str]] = []
    stale = decl = has_comment = cached = 0
    for it in rows:
        if args.path_filter and args.path_filter.replace("\\", "/") not in it["file"]:
            continue
        lines = src.lines(it["file"])
        got = extract_body(lines, it["line"], it["name"]) if lines else None
        if got is None:
            stale += 1
            continue
        mode, body = got
        if mode == "DECL":
            decl += 1
            continue
        key = body_key(it, body)
        if key in cache:
            cached += 1
            continue
        if (it.get("purpose") or "").strip():
            has_comment += 1
            continue
        todo.append((tokens.get(it["name"].lower(), 0), it, key, body))

    todo.sort(key=lambda t: -t[0])
    print(f"Harita: {out_dir.name}  rutin kaydı: {len(rows)}")
    print(f"  prototip (declare, atlandı): {decl}   eskimiş kayıt: {stale}   zaten yorumlu: {has_comment}   önbellekte: {cached}")
    print(f"  üretilecek: {len(todo)}   model: {args.model}")

    if args.dry_run:
        for score, it, _k, body in todo[:10]:
            print(f"   öncelik {score:>5}  {it['kind']:<8} {it['name']}  {it['file']}:{it['line']}  ({len(body)} karakter)")
        return 0
    if not todo:
        print("Yapılacak iş yok.")
        return 0

    cache_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    total = min(len(todo), args.limit) if args.limit else len(todo)
    started = time.time()
    recent: list[float] = []
    done = 0
    try:
        with cache_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as out:
            for score, it, key, body in todo[:total]:
                if args.max_minutes and (time.time() - started) / 60 >= args.max_minutes:
                    print("Süre doldu, kaldığı yerden devam edilebilir.")
                    break
                head = body.splitlines()[0].strip()
                user_text = f"Dosya: {it['file']}\nKapsayıcı: {it.get('container') or '-'}\n\n```freebasic\n{shorten(body)}\n```"
                t0 = time.time()
                ans = clean_answer(ask_ollama(args.model, user_text))
                lang = "tr"
                if looks_english(ans):
                    ans = clean_answer(ask_ollama(args.model, user_text, strict=True))
                    if looks_english(ans):
                        lang = "en"
                dt = time.time() - t0
                rec = {
                    "key": key, "file": it["file"], "line": it["line"], "kind": it["kind"], "name": it["name"],
                    "container": it.get("container") or "", "signature": head[:200], "purpose": ans,
                    "lang": lang, "source": "llm", "model": args.model, "sec": round(dt, 1),
                    "ts": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"),
                }
                out.write(json.dumps(rec, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
                out.flush()
                done += 1
                recent = (recent + [dt])[-20:]
                eta_min = (total - done) * (sum(recent) / len(recent)) / 60
                print(f"[{done}/{total}] {dt:4.1f}sn  kalan ~{eta_min:6.0f} dk  {it['name']}: {ans[:90]}")
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\nDurduruldu. Kayıtlar korunuyor, sonra kaldığı yerden devam edilir.")
    print(f"Bu çalıştırmada üretilen: {done}  toplam süre: {(time.time()-started)/60:.1f} dk")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Mevcut Moduller ile UXBc harita ve indeks çıktılarını üretir.")
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", default=str(WORKSPACE_ROOT))
    parser.add_argument("--out", default="")
    parser.add_argument("--roots", default=",".join(DEFAULT_ROOTS))
    parser.add_argument("--modules", default="statik,topolojik,davranissal,cli,kalite,guvenlik,rag")
    parser.add_argument("--max-file-kb", type=int, default=1024)
    parser.add_argument("--skip-modules", action="store_true", help="Sadece yüzey/sembol envanteri üretir; analiz modüllerini çalıştırmaz.")
    parser.add_argument("--dashboard", action="store_true", help="RaporBirlestirici HTML panosunu da üretir. Büyük projelerde yavaş olabilir.")
    parser.add_argument("--full-inventory", action="store_true", help="Tam düz sembol listesini ayrıca symbol_inventory_full.json olarak yazar.")
    parser.add_argument("--all-code-symbols", action="store_true", help="Sembol taramasına C/Python/Markdown gibi tüm kod uzantılarını da dahil eder.")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    workspace = Path(args.workspace).resolve()
    roots = [x.strip().replace("\\", "/") for x in args.roots.split(",") if x.strip()]
    timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    out_dir = Path(args.out).resolve() if args.out else workspace / "reports" / "uxb_map_system" / timestamp
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    code_paths = iter_files(workspace, roots, CODE_EXTS, args.max_file_kb * 1024)
    basic_paths = [p for p in code_paths if p.suffix.lower() in BASIC_EXTS]
    all_files = make_all_files(basic_paths, workspace)
    symbol_paths = code_paths if args.all_code_symbols else basic_paths

    print(f"[uxb-map] çalışma ağacı={workspace}", flush=True)
    print(f"[uxb-map] çıktı dizini={out_dir}", flush=True)
    print(f"[uxb-map] kod dosyası={len(code_paths)} basic/freebasic dosyası={len(basic_paths)}", flush=True)
    print(f"[uxb-map] sembol tarama dosyası={len(symbol_paths)}", flush=True)

    symbol_inventory_full = collect_symbols(symbol_paths, workspace)
    symbol_inventory = make_symbol_lookup(symbol_inventory_full)
    print(f"[uxb-map] sembol sayısı={symbol_inventory['symbol_count']}", flush=True)
    surface_inventory = collect_surface(code_paths, workspace)
    print("[uxb-map] dil yüzeyi çıkarıldı", flush=True)
    json_dump(out_dir / "symbol_inventory.json", symbol_inventory)
    if args.full_inventory:
        json_dump(out_dir / "symbol_inventory_full.json", symbol_inventory_full)
    json_dump(out_dir / "surface_inventory.json", surface_inventory)

    results: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if not args.skip_modules:
        modules = [x.strip() for x in args.modules.split(",") if x.strip()]
        results = run_existing_modules(all_files, out_dir, modules)
    if results:
        json_dump(out_dir / "module_results.json", results)

    master_path = write_master_report(out_dir, results)
    if args.dashboard and not args.skip_modules:
        try:
            from RaporBirlestirici import RaporBirlestirici
            RaporBirlestirici(str(out_dir)).rapor_kaydet("all")
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"[uxb-map] pano üretimi atlandı: {exc}", flush=True)

    surface_counts = compact_surface_counts(surface_inventory)
    summary = {
        "created_at": datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "workspace": str(workspace),
        "output_dir": str(out_dir),
        "roots": roots,
        "inventory": {
            "scanned_code_files": len(code_paths),
            "analyzed_basic_files": len(basic_paths),
            "symbols": {
                "symbol_count": symbol_inventory["symbol_count"],
                "kind_counts": symbol_inventory["kind_counts"],
            },
            "surface": {
                "counts": surface_counts,
            },
        },
        "module_status": compact_module_status(results),
        "outputs": {
            "summary": str(out_dir / "UXBC_MAP_SUMMARY.md"),
            "symbol_inventory": str(out_dir / "symbol_inventory.json"),
            "symbol_inventory_full": str(out_dir / "symbol_inventory_full.json") if args.full_inventory else "",
            "surface_inventory": str(out_dir / "surface_inventory.json"),
            "module_results": str(out_dir / "module_results.json") if results else "",
            "master_report": str(master_path),
        },
    }
    json_dump(out_dir / "uxbc_map_summary.json", summary)
    write_markdown(out_dir / "UXBC_MAP_SUMMARY.md", summary)

    latest = workspace / "reports" / "uxb_map_system" / "latest_summary.json"
    json_dump(latest, {"created_at": summary["created_at"], "output_dir": str(out_dir), "summary": summary["outputs"]["summary"]})

    print(f"[uxb-map] tamamlandı: {out_dir / 'UXBC_MAP_SUMMARY.md'}", flush=True)
    return 0

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
UXBc ajan paketi kurucusu (Claude ve Codex için "tekdosya" düşük-token paketi).

Girdi : en son harita envanteri (symbol_inventory_full.json) + amaç önbelleği (uxb_purpose_fill.py)
Çıktı : ajan_paketi/  -> OKU_BENI.md, kapsam.md, rutinler.tsv, modul_dizini.tsv,
                         moduller/M*.md (boyut sınırlı paketler), tipler/T*.md

Amaç cümlelerinin kaynağı her satırda etiketlenir:
  [yorum]      kaynak kodda rutinin hemen üstündeki yorum satırı (doğruluğu garanti değil)
  [llm]        yerel modelin taslağı (DOĞRULANMADI; kullanmadan önce kaynağı oku)
  [tanimdan:x] prototipin (declare) adı aynı olan tanımdan miras aldığı amaç

Örnek:
  python tools\\uxb_ajan_paketi.py
  python tools\\uxb_ajan_paketi.py --size 48
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import sys
import time
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import uxb_purpose_fill as pf  # noqa: E402

V4 = pf.V4
WORKSPACE = pf.WORKSPACE
TYPE_KINDS = {"TYPE", "ENUM", "CLASS", "UNION", "STRUCT", "INTERFACE"}
INCLUDE_RE = re.compile(r'(?i)^\s*#?\s*include(?:\s+once)?\s+["<]([^">]+)[">]')
TOP_DIRS = {"src", "include", "libsx", "runtime_ext", "native", "compiler", "libs"}


def load_layer_rules() -> tuple[dict, list]:
    cfg_path = V4 / "config.core.json"
    if not cfg_path.exists():
        return {}, []
    cfg = json.loads(cfg_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return cfg.get("layer_path_rules", {}), cfg.get("layer_order", [])


def layer_of(rel: str, rules: dict, order: list) -> str:
    toks = [t for t in re.split(r"[^a-z0-9]+", rel.lower()) if t]
    if toks and toks[0] == "uxb":
        toks = toks[1:]
    if toks and toks[0] in TOP_DIRS:
        toks = toks[1:]
    for layer in order:
        for term in rules.get(layer, []):
            t = term.lower()
            if any(tok == t or (len(t) >= 5 and t in tok) for tok in toks):
                return layer
    return "-"


def tsv(s: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[\t\r\n]+", " ", s or "").strip()


def group_chunks(sections: list[tuple[str, str]], limit_bytes: int) -> list[list[tuple[str, str]]]:
    chunks: list[list[tuple[str, str]]] = []
    cur: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    size = 0
    for key, text in sections:
        n = len(text.encode("utf-8"))
        if cur and size + n > limit_bytes:
            chunks.append(cur)
            cur, size = [], 0
        cur.append((key, text))
        size += n
    if cur:
        chunks.append(cur)
    return chunks


def slug(path: str) -> str:
    d = os.path.dirname(path).replace("\\", "/")
    return re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", d).strip("_")[:40] or "kok"


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Claude/Codex için düşük-token ajan paketi üretir.")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default=str(V4 / "ajan_paketi"))
    ap.add_argument("--size", type=int, default=64, help="Modül/tip paketlerinin hedef üst sınırı (KB).")
    ap.add_argument("--cache", default=str(pf.DEFAULT_CACHE))
    args = ap.parse_args()

    out = Path(args.out)
    (out / "moduller").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (out / "tipler").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for old in list((out / "moduller").glob("M*.md")) + list((out / "tipler").glob("T*.md")):
        old.unlink()

    symbols, map_dir = pf.load_all_symbols()
    map_time = (map_dir / "symbol_inventory.json").stat().st_mtime
    cache = pf.load_cache(Path(args.cache))
    rules, order = load_layer_rules()
    src = pf.SourceCache()

    # ---------- rutinler ----------
    routines: list[dict] = []
    stale = 0
    defs_by_name: dict[str, list[dict]] = defaultdict(list)
    for it in symbols:
        if it["kind"] not in pf.ROUTINE_KINDS:
            continue
        lines = src.lines(it["file"])
        got = pf.extract_body(lines, it["line"], it["name"]) if lines else None
        if got is None:
            stale += 1
            continue
        mode, body = got
        header = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", lines[it["line"] - 1]).strip()[:170]
        psrc, purpose = "", ""
        c = pf.usable_comment(it.get("purpose") or "")
        if c:
            psrc, purpose = "yorum", c
        elif mode == "DEF":
            rec = cache.get(pf.body_key(it, body))
            if rec and rec.get("valid"):
                psrc, purpose = "llm", rec["purpose"]
        r = {"name": it["name"], "kind": it["kind"], "container": it.get("container") or "", "file": it["file"],
             "line": it["line"], "mode": mode, "header": header, "psrc": psrc, "purpose": purpose,
             "llm_invalid": mode == "DEF" and not psrc and (pf.body_key(it, body) in cache)}
        routines.append(r)
        if mode == "DEF" and purpose:
            defs_by_name[it["name"].lower()].append(r)
    for r in routines:
        if r["mode"] == "DECL" and not r["purpose"]:
            cand = defs_by_name.get(r["name"].lower())
            if cand:
                r["psrc"], r["purpose"] = f"tanimdan:{cand[0]['psrc']}", cand[0]["purpose"]

    by_file: dict[str, list[dict]] = defaultdict(list)
    for r in routines:
        by_file[r["file"]].append(r)

    # ---------- modül paketleri ----------
    sections: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    file_meta: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for f in sorted(by_file):
        lines = src.lines(f) or []
        incs: list[str] = []
        for ln in lines:
            m = INCLUDE_RE.match(ln)
            if m and m.group(1) not in incs:
                incs.append(m.group(1))
        rs = sorted(by_file[f], key=lambda x: x["line"])
        layer = layer_of(f, rules, order)
        file_meta[f] = {"lines": len(lines), "routines": len(rs), "with_purpose": sum(1 for x in rs if x["purpose"]), "layer": layer}
        inc_txt = ", ".join(incs[:8]) + (f" (+{len(incs) - 8})" if len(incs) > 8 else "")
        buf = [f"### {f}  · katman: {layer} · {len(lines)} satır" + (f" · include: {inc_txt}" if incs else "") + "\n"]
        for x in rs:
            tag = " [prototip]" if x["mode"] == "DECL" else ""
            line = f"- L{x['line']} `{x['header']}`{tag}"
            if x["purpose"]:
                line += f" — {x['purpose']} [{x['psrc']}]"
            buf.append(line + "\n")
        buf.append("\n")
        sections.append((f, "".join(buf)))

    limit = args.size * 1024
    chunks = group_chunks(sections, limit)
    pkg_of: dict[str, str] = {}
    for i, ch in enumerate(chunks, start=1):
        name = f"M{i:02d}_{slug(ch[0][0])}.md"
        head = (f"# UXBc modül haritası — paket {i}/{len(chunks)}\n"
                f"Satır biçimi: `L<satır> <imza>` — <amaç> [kaynak]. Etiketler: yorum=kaynaktaki bitişik yorum, "
                f"llm=yerel model taslağı (DOĞRULANMADI), tanimdan=prototip amacı tanımdan alındı.\n\n")
        (out / "moduller" / name).write_text(head + "".join(t for _, t in ch), encoding="utf-8")
        for f, _ in ch:
            pkg_of[f] = name

    # ---------- rutinler.tsv ----------
    with (out / "rutinler.tsv").open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as fh:
        fh.write("ad\ttur\tkapsayici\tdosya\tsatir\tpaket\tkaynak\tamac\timza\n")
        for r in sorted(routines, key=lambda x: (x["name"].lower(), x["file"], x["line"])):
            fh.write("\t".join([tsv(r["name"]), r["kind"] + ("*" if r["mode"] == "DECL" else ""), tsv(r["container"]), r["file"],
                                str(r["line"]), pkg_of.get(r["file"], ""), r["psrc"] or "-", tsv(r["purpose"]), tsv(r["header"])]) + "\n")

    with (out / "modul_dizini.tsv").open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as fh:
        fh.write("dosya\tpaket\tsatir\trutin\tamacli_rutin\tkatman\n")
        for f in sorted(file_meta):
            m = file_meta[f]
            fh.write(f"{f}\t{pkg_of.get(f, '')}\t{m['lines']}\t{m['routines']}\t{m['with_purpose']}\t{m['layer']}\n")

    # ---------- tipler ----------
    fields: dict[tuple[str, str], list[dict]] = defaultdict(list)
    for it in symbols:
        if it["kind"] == "FIELD":
            fields[(it["file"], it.get("container") or "")].append(it)
    tsections: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    types_by_file: dict[str, list[dict]] = defaultdict(list)
    n_types = 0
    for it in symbols:
        if it["kind"] in TYPE_KINDS:
            types_by_file[it["file"]].append(it)
            n_types += 1
    for f in sorted(types_by_file):
        buf = [f"### {f}\n"]
        for t in sorted(types_by_file[f], key=lambda x: x["line"]):
            c = pf.usable_comment(t.get("purpose") or "")
            buf.append(f"- {t['kind']} **{t['name']}** @L{t['line']}" + (f" — {c} [yorum]" if c else "") + "\n")
            for fl in sorted(fields.get((f, t["name"]), []), key=lambda x: x["line"]):
                buf.append(f"  · {fl['name']} As {fl.get('output') or '?'}\n")
        buf.append("\n")
        tsections.append((f, "".join(buf)))
    tchunks = group_chunks(tsections, limit)
    for i, ch in enumerate(tchunks, start=1):
        name = f"T{i:02d}_{slug(ch[0][0])}.md"
        head = f"# UXBc tip/enum/sınıf haritası — paket {i}/{len(tchunks)}\n\n"
        (out / "tipler" / name).write_text(head + "".join(t for _, t in ch), encoding="utf-8")

    # ---------- kapsam.md ----------
    total = len(routines)
    defs = [r for r in routines if r["mode"] == "DEF"]
    decls = [r for r in routines if r["mode"] == "DECL"]
    n_yorum = sum(1 for r in defs if r["psrc"] == "yorum")
    n_llm = sum(1 for r in defs if r["psrc"] == "llm")
    n_bad = sum(1 for r in defs if r["llm_invalid"])
    n_none = sum(1 for r in defs if not r["purpose"])
    n_decl_inh = sum(1 for r in decls if r["purpose"])
    changed = sum(1 for f in by_file if (WORKSPACE / f).stat().st_mtime > map_time)
    models = sorted({v.get("model", "?") for v in cache.values()})
    pct = lambda a, b: f"%{100 * a / max(1, b):.1f}"
    kapsam = f"""# Kapsam ve güven raporu

Paket üretimi: {time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}
Harita kaynağı: `{map_dir.name}` ({time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M', time.localtime(map_time))})
Haritadan sonra değişen kaynak dosya: {changed} / {len(by_file)}  (0 değilse `scripts\\41_ajan_paketi_yenile.bat` çalıştır)

## Rutinler
- Toplam rutin kaydı: {total}  (tanım: {len(defs)}, prototip/declare: {len(decls)}, eskimiş atlanan: {stale})
- Tanımlarda amaç durumu:
  - yorum kaynaklı: {n_yorum} ({pct(n_yorum, len(defs))})
  - yerel model taslağı (llm, doğrulanmadı): {n_llm} ({pct(n_llm, len(defs))})
  - model "belirsiz" dedi / geçersiz: {n_bad}
  - amaç henüz yok: {n_none} ({pct(n_none, len(defs))})
- Prototiplerde tanımdan miras alınan amaç: {n_decl_inh} / {len(decls)}
- Tip/enum/sınıf kaydı: {n_types}

## Güven düzeyi
- İmza (parametre, dönüş tipi), dosya ve satır bilgisi kaynak koddan doğrudan okunur; güvenilirdir.
- `[yorum]`: rutinin hemen üstündeki yorum satırı. Yanlış rutine yapışmış olabilir.
- `[llm]`: model(ler): {', '.join(models) or 'yok'}. Üç milyar parametreli yerel model; kısaltmaları yanlış açabilir
  ve ayrıntıyı atlayabilir. Karar vermeden önce kaynak koda bak.

## Bu pakette OLMAYANLAR
- Dil yüzeyi (lexer anahtar kelimeleri, preprocessor komutları, operatörler, veri tipleri): mevcut envanter
  gürültülü (ölçüm: preprocessor adlarının yalnız 7/73'ü FreeBASIC/uXBasic kaynağında geçiyor). Gerçek lexer
  tablolarından ayrıca çıkarılmalı; bu pakete güvenilir diye konmadı.
- C/C++/Python/PowerShell kaynakları: harita yalnız .fbs/.bas/.bi/.inc/.fb dosyalarını kapsar.
- Global değişkenler, sabitler ve yerel değişkenler: ayrı listelenmedi (harita envanterinde var).
- Çağrı grafiği / etki analizi: yok; adın kaynakta geçtiği yerler için `rg -w <ad> uxb/src` kullan.
"""
    (out / "kapsam.md").write_text(kapsam, encoding="utf-8")

    (out / "OKU_BENI.md").write_text(f"""# UXBc ajan paketi — önce bunu oku

Amaç: büyük kaynak dosyalarını okumadan "bu rutin nerede, ne yapar, imzası ne, hangi dosyada" sorularını
az token ile yanıtlamak. Bu paket harita envanterinden otomatik üretilir; elle düzenleme, yeniden üretilince silinir.

## Sıra
1. `rutinler.tsv` — tek satırda bir rutin. Ara: `rg -i "^<ad>\\t" ajan_paketi/rutinler.tsv`
   Sütunlar: ad, tur (* = prototip), kapsayici, dosya, satir, paket, kaynak, amac, imza.
2. `moduller/<paket>.md` — o dosyanın tüm rutinleri (imza + amaç). Paket adı rutinler.tsv'deki `paket` sütunundadır.
3. `modul_dizini.tsv` — dosya bazında katman, satır sayısı, kaç rutinin amacı bilinir.

import json
import os
import re
import sys
import time
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import uxb_purpose_fill as pf  # noqa: E402

V4 = pf.V4
WORKSPACE = pf.WORKSPACE
TYPE_KINDS = {"TYPE", "ENUM", "CLASS", "UNION", "STRUCT", "INTERFACE"}
INCLUDE_RE = re.compile(r'(?i)^\s*#?\s*include(?:\s+once)?\s+["<]([^">]+)[">]')

def load_layer_rules() -> tuple[dict, list]:
    cfg_path = V4 / "config.core.json"
    if not cfg_path.exists():
        return {}, []
    cfg = json.loads(cfg_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return cfg.get("layer_path_rules", {}), cfg.get("layer_order", [])


def layer_of(rel: str, rules: dict, order: list) -> str:
    toks = [t for t in re.split(r"[^a-z0-9]+", rel.lower()) if t]
    if toks and toks[0] == "uxb":
        toks = toks[1:]
    if toks and toks[0] in TOP_DIRS:
        toks = toks[1:]
    for layer in order:

    chunks: list[list[tuple[str, str]]] = []

        for ln in lines:

        rs = sorted(by_file[f], key=lambda x: x["line"])
        layer = layer_of(f, rules, order)
        file_meta[f] = {"lines": len(lines), "routines": len(rs), "with_purpose": sum(1 for x in rs if x["purpose"]), "layer": layer}

        buf = [f"### {f}  · katman: {layer} · {len(lines)} satır" + (f" · include: {inc_txt}" if incs else "") + "\n"]
        for x in rs:

            line = f"- L{x['line']} `{x['header']}`{tag}"
            if x["purpose"]:

        head = f"# UXBc tip/enum/sınıf haritası — paket {i}/{len(tchunks)}\n\n"
        (out / "tipler" / name).write_text(head + "".join(t for _, t in ch), encoding="utf-8")

    kapsam = f"""# Kapsam ve güven raporu

Paket üretimi: {time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}
